exec(open("_lib.py").read())
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, requests, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
Pseq="MTIFEKKPDFTLFLQTLSWEIDDQVGIEVRNELLREVGRGMGTRIMPPPCQTVDKLQIELNALLALIGWGTVTLELLSEDQSLRIVHENLPQVGSAGEPSGTWLAPVLEGLYGRWVTSQAGAFGDYVVTRDVDAEDLNAVPRQTIIMYMRVRSSAT"
seqs=json.load(open("bcsD_homologs.json"))
B62=requests.get("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/biopython/biopython/master/Bio/Align/substitution_matrices/data/BLOSUM62",timeout=60).text
lines=[l for l in B62.splitlines() if l and not l.startswith("#")]; hdr=lines[0].split(); M={}
for l in lines[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for b,v in zip(hdr,p[1:]): M[(p[0],b)]=int(v)
def nw(a,b,gap=-8):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); S=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); S[0,:]=np.arange(m+1)*gap; S[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*gap
    T=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=np.int8); T[0,1:]=2; T[1:,0]=1
    sc=np.array([[M.get((x,y),-4) for y in b] for x in a],dtype=float)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        diag=S[i-1,:-1]+sc[i-1]; row=S[i]; prev=S[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=diag[j-1]; up=prev[j]+gap; le=row[j-1]+gap
            if d>=up and d>=le: row[j]=d; T[i,j]=0
            elif up>=le: row[j]=up; T[i,j]=1
            else: row[j]=le; T[i,j]=2
    i,j=n,m; ali=[None]*n
    while i>0 or j>0:
        t=T[i,j]
        if t==0: ali[i-1]=b[j-1]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif t==1: ali[i-1]="-"; i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return ali
ali=np.array([nw(Pseq,v[1]) for v in seqs.values()]); ref=np.array(list(Pseq))
pid=(ali==ref[None,:]).mean(1)
lin=[6,7,9,11,12,15,61,62,65,66,67,68,92,94]
nclose=int((pid>0.5).sum())
rows=[]
for lab,mask in [("close orthologs >50pc id (n={})".format(nclose), pid>0.5),
                 ("all PF03500 (n={})".format(len(pid)), np.ones_like(pid,bool))]:
    ident=(ali[mask]==ref[None,:]).mean(0)
    rows.append(pd.DataFrame(dict(set=lab,pos=np.arange(1,157),aa=list(Pseq),identity=np.round(ident,2))))
CONS=pd.concat(rows); CONS.to_csv("conservation_stratified.csv",index=False)
for lab,g in CONS.groupby("set",sort=False):
    L=g[g.pos.isin(lin)]; O=g[~g.pos.isin(lin)]
    u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(L.identity,O.identity); s=g.set_index('pos').identity
    print("{}: lining mean {:.2f} vs rest {:.2f} (MWU p={:.3f})".format(lab,L.identity.mean(),O.identity.mean(),p))
    print("   K6={:.2f} K7={:.2f} D9={:.2f} T11={:.2f} Q15={:.2f} N61={:.2f} Q92={:.2f}".format(s[6],s[7],s[9],s[11],s[15],s[61],s[92]))

B=framed("3A8E"); P8=B[B.resn!="BGC"]; sug=B[B.resn=="BGC"]
t=cKDTree(sug[["px","py","pz"]].values); others=cKDTree(P8[["px","py","pz"]].values)
print("\nlocation of the most conserved residues (chain A of the octamer):")
for r in [69,115,112,87,61,91,110]:
    a=P8[(P8.uchain=="A_0")&(P8.resi==r)]
    if not len(a): continue
    X=a[["px","py","pz"]].values
    print("   {}{}: min distance to any bound glucan {:.1f} A ; atoms within 8 A = {:.0f}".format(
        a.resn.iloc[0],r,t.query(X)[0].min(), np.mean([len(x) for x in others.query_ball_point(X,8.0)])))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(14.5,4.3))
ax=axes[0]; T=pd.read_csv("compartment_threshold_scan.csv")
ax.plot(T.probe_radius_A,T.distinct_components_among_4_sites,"o-",color="#dd6b20",label="separate compartments among the 4 sites")
ax.plot(T.probe_radius_A,T.n_top_to_bottom_routes,"s--",color="#2b6cb0",label="routes spanning the cylinder")
ax.axvline(4.1,color="k",ls=":",lw=1); ax.text(4.15,3.0,"glucan chain\nhalf-thickness",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("probe radius (A)"); ax.set_ylabel("count"); ax.legend(fontsize=7); ax.grid(alpha=.3)
ax.set_title("Four compartments and through-passage\nnever coexist")
ax=axes[1]; P=pd.read_csv("tunnel_radius_profiles.csv")
a=P[P.case=="AcsD_helix_3A8E"]; b=P[P.case=="BcsA_glucan_4HG6"]
ax.plot(a.s,a.R,"-",color="#dd6b20",label="AcsD helical path (3A8E)")
ax.plot(b.s,b.R,"-",color="#2b6cb0",label="BcsA glucan path (4HG6)")
ax.axhline(4.1,color="k",ls=":",lw=1); ax.axvspan(-11.2,11.2,color="#dd6b20",alpha=.12)
ax.set_xlabel("path position, 0 = centre of bound glucan (A)"); ax.set_ylabel("inscribed sphere radius (A)")
ax.legend(fontsize=7); ax.grid(alpha=.3); ax.set_title("Local pore radius matches a real\ntranslocation channel")
ax=axes[2]; g=CONS[CONS.set.str.startswith("all")]
ax.scatter(g.pos,g.identity,s=8,color="#a0aec0",label="all positions")
gl=g[g.pos.isin(lin)]; ax.scatter(gl.pos,gl.identity,s=42,color="#dd6b20",zorder=5,label="glucan-site lining")
s=g.set_index('pos').identity
for p_ in [6,7,61,69,115]:
    ax.annotate("{}{}".format(Pseq[p_-1],p_),(p_,float(s[p_])),fontsize=8,xytext=(3,4),textcoords="offset points")
ax.set_xlabel("AcsD residue position"); ax.set_ylabel("identity across 491 PF03500 homologs")
ax.legend(fontsize=7); ax.grid(alpha=.3); ax.set_title("Lining positions are not conserved")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
